arxiv-1712-05052.title: Viscous dynamics of vortices in a ferromagnetic film
arxiv-1712-05052.creator: Derek Reitz, Anirban Ghosh, Oleg Tchernyshyov
arxiv-1712-05052.description: Abstract We derive viscous forces for vortices in a thin-film ferromagnet. The viscous force acting on vortex i i is a linear superposition 𝐅 i = − ∑ j D ^ i ​ j 𝐕 j \mathbf{F}_{i}=-\sum_{j}\hat{D}_{ij}\mathbf{V}_{j} , where 𝐕 j \mathbf{V}_{j} is the velocity of vortex j j .

arxiv-2008-07927.title: Modulation of Dirac electrons in epitaxial Bi 2 Se 3 ultrathin films on van-der-Waals ferromagnet Cr 2 Si 2 Te 6
arxiv-2008-07927.creator: Takemi Kato, 1 Katsuaki Sugawara, 1,2,3 Naohiro Ito, 1 Kunihiko Yamauchi, 4 Takumi Sato, 1 Tamio Oguchi, 4 Takashi Takahashi, 1,2,3 Yuki Shiomi, 5 Eiji Saitoh, 2,3,6,7,8 and Takafumi Sato 1,2,3
arxiv-2008-07927.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Takemi Kato, 1 Katsuaki Sugawara, 1,2,3 Naohiro Ito, 1 Kunihiko Yamauchi, 4 Takumi Sato, 1 Tamio Oguchi, 4 Takashi Takahashi, 1,2,3 Yuki Shiomi, 5 Eiji Saitoh, 2,3,6,7,8 and Takafumi Sato 1,2,3. We investigated the Dirac-cone state and its modulation when an ultrathin film of topological insulator Bi 2 Se 3 was epitaxially grown on a van-der-Waals ferromagnet Cr 2 Si 2 Te 6 (CST) by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy.

arxiv-2104-05227.title: Fabrication of Ultra-High Q Silica Microdisk Using Chemo-Mechanical Polishing
arxiv-2104-05227.creator: S. Honari, S. Haque, T.Lu
arxiv-2104-05227.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Honari, S. Haque, T.Lu. Here we demonstrate that adding a chemo-mechanical polishing (CMP) procedure to conventional photolithography, a silica microdisk with ultra-high quality factors ( > 10 8 >10^{8} ) can be fabricated. By comparing with the intrinsic optical quality factor (Q) measured at 970 nm, we observe that due to the significantly reduced surface roughness, at 1550 nm wavelength the water molecule absorption at the cavity surface supersedes Rayleigh scattering as the dominant factor for Q degradation.

arxiv-2106-06286.title: First on-sky demonstration of spatial Linear Dark Field Control with the vector-Apodizing Phase Plate at Subaru/SCExAO Thanks: Based on data collected at Subaru Telescope, which is operated by the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.
arxiv-2106-06286.creator: S.P. Bos ,, K.L. Miller, J. Lozi, O. Guyon, D.S. Doelman, S. Vievard, A. Sahoo, V. Deo, N. Jovanovic, F. Martinache, T. Currie, F. Snik
arxiv-2106-06286.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S.P. Bos ,, K.L. Miller, J. Lozi, O. Guyon, D.S. Doelman, S. Vievard, A. Sahoo, V. Deo, N. Jovanovic, F. Martinache, T. Currie, F. Snik. One of the key noise sources that currently limits high-contrast imaging observations for exoplanet detection is quasi-static speckles. Quasi-static speckles originate from slowly evolving non-common path aberrations (NCPA).

arxiv-2109-00980.title: Asymptotic stability of solutions to the Navier–Stokes–Fourier system driven by inhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions
arxiv-2109-00980.creator: Eduard Feireisl, Young–Sam Kwon
arxiv-2109-00980.description: Abstract We consider global in time solutions of the Navier–Stokes–Fourier system describing the motion of a general compressible, viscous and heat conducting fluid far from equilibirum. Using a new concept of weak solution suitable to accommodate the inhomogeneous Dirichlet time dependent data we find sufficient conditions for the global in time weak solutions to be ultimately bounded.

arxiv-2109-11308.title: Breaking BERT: Understanding its Vulnerabilities for Named Entity Recognition through Adversarial Attack
arxiv-2109-11308.creator: Anne Dirkson, Suzan Verberne, Wessel Kraaij
arxiv-2109-11308.description: Abstract Both generic and domain-specific BERT models are widely used for natural language processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper we investigate the vulnerability of BERT models to variation in input data for Named Entity Recognition (NER) through adversarial attack. Experimental results show that BERT models are vulnerable to variation in the entity context with 20.2 to 45.

arxiv-2111-03645.title: Gravitino constraints on supergravity inflation
arxiv-2111-03645.creator: Shinsuke Kawai, Nobuchika Okada
arxiv-2111-03645.description: Abstract Supergravity embedding of the Standard Model of particle physics provides phenomenologically well-motivated and observationally viable inflationary scenarios. We investigate a class of inflationary models based on the superconformal framework of supergravity and discuss constraints from the reheating temperature, with the particular focus on the gravitino problem inherent in these scenarios.

arxiv-2202-04261.title: THE VOLCSPEECH SYSTEM FOR THE ICASSP 2022 MULTI-CHANNEL MULTI-PARTY MEETING TRANSCRIPTION CHALLENGE
arxiv-2202-04261.creator: Chen Shen, Yi Liu, Wenzhi Fan, Bin Wang, Shixue Wen, Yao Tian, Jun Zhang, Jingsheng Yang, Zejun Ma
arxiv-2202-04261.description: Abstract This paper describes our submission to ICASSP 2022 Multi-channel Multi-party Meeting Transcription (M2MeT) Challenge. For Track 1, we propose several approaches to empower the clustering-based speaker diarization system to handle overlapped speech. Front-end dereverberation and the direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation are used to improve the accuracy of speaker diarization.

arxiv-2209-07564.title: Direct vs Indirect Methods for Behavior-based Attack Detection
arxiv-2209-07564.creator: Darshan Gadginmath, Vishaal Krishnan, Fabio Pasqualetti
arxiv-2209-07564.description: Abstract We study the problem of data-driven attack detection for unknown LTI systems using only input-output behavioral data. In contrast with model-based detectors that use errors from an output predictor to detect attacks, we study behavior-based data-driven detectors. We construct a behavior-based chi-squared detector that uses a sequence of inputs and outputs and their covariance.

arxiv-2405-20521.title: SoK: Public Blockchain Sharding Thanks: This work was supported in part by the US National Science Foundation under grants 2247560, 2154929, 1916902, and 2331936, by the Office of Naval Research under grant N00014-19-1-2621, and by the Virginia Commonwealth Cyber Initiative (CCI). PubID: pubid: 979-
arxiv-2405-20521.creator: Md Mohaimin Al Barat, Shaoyu Li, Changlai Du, Y. Thomas Hou, and Wenjing Lou
arxiv-2405-20521.description: Abstract Blockchain’s decentralization, transparency, and tamper-resistance properties have facilitated the system’s use in various application fields. However, the low throughput and high confirmation latency hinder the widespread adoption of Blockchain. Many solutions have been proposed to address these issues, including first-layer solutions (or on-chain solutions) and second-layer solutions (or off-chain solutions).

arxiv-2407-12838.title: Historical Ink: 19th Century Latin American Spanish Newspaper Corpus with LLM OCR Correction
arxiv-2407-12838.creator: Laura Manrique-Gómez, Tony Montes, Arturo Rodríguez-Herrera, Rubén Manrique
arxiv-2407-12838.description: Abstract This paper presents two significant contributions: First, it introduces a novel dataset of 19th-century Latin American newspaper texts, addressing a critical gap in specialized corpora for historical and linguistic analysis in this region. Second, it develops a flexible framework that utilizes a Large Language Model for OCR error correction and linguistic surface form detection in digitized corpora.

arxiv-2411-15922.title: PromptHSI: Universal Hyperspectral Image Restoration with Vision-Language Modulated Frequency Adaptation
arxiv-2411-15922.creator: Chia-Ming Lee, Ching-Heng Cheng, Yu-Fan Lin, Yi-Ching Cheng, Wo-Ting Liao, Chih-Chung Hsu †, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Institute of Data Science, National Cheng Kung University, Graduate Institute of Communication Engineering, National Taiwan University NVIDIA
arxiv-2411-15922.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chia-Ming Lee, Ching-Heng Cheng, Yu-Fan Lin, Yi-Ching Cheng, Wo-Ting Liao, Chih-Chung Hsu †, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Institute of Data Science, National Cheng Kung University, Graduate Institute of Communication Engineering, National Taiwan University NVIDIA. Recent advances in All-in-One (AiO) RGB image restoration have demonstrated the effectiveness of prompt learning in handling multiple degradations within a single model.

arxiv-2501-07404.title: Reconstruction of quantum states by applying an analytical optimization model
arxiv-2501-07404.creator: Rohit Prasad, Pratyay Ghosh, Ronny Thomale, Tobias Huber-Loyola
arxiv-2501-07404.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rohit Prasad, Pratyay Ghosh, Ronny Thomale, Tobias Huber-Loyola. When working with quantum states, analysis of the final quantum state generated through probabilistic measurements is essential. This analysis is typically conducted by constructing the density matrix from either partial or full tomography measurements of the quantum state. While full tomography measurement offers the most accurate reconstruction of the density matrix, limited measurements pose challenges for reconstruction algorithms, often resulting in non-physical density matrices with negative eigenvalues.

arxiv-2503-02315.title: Incorporating Graph Neural Networks into Route Choice Models
arxiv-2503-02315.creator: Ma Yuxun, Toru Seo
arxiv-2503-02315.description: Abstract Route choice models are one of the most important foundations for transportation research. Traditionally, theory-based models have been utilized for their great interpretability, such as logit models and Recursive Logit models. Recently, hybrid models that incorporate machine learning into discrete choice models have gained increasing attention.

arxiv-2506-15170.title: From LLMs to MLLMs to Agents: A Survey of Emerging Paradigms in Jailbreak Attacks and Defenses within LLM Ecosystem
arxiv-2506-15170.creator: Yanxu Mao, Tiehan Cui, Peipei Liu, Datao You, Hongsong Zhu
arxiv-2506-15170.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving from single-modal systems to multimodal LLMs and intelligent agents, significantly expanding their capabilities while introducing increasingly severe security risks. This paper presents a systematic survey of the growing complexity of jailbreak attacks and corresponding defense mechanisms within the expanding LLM ecosystem.

arxiv-2507-12534.title: Scalable dissipative quantum error correction for discrete-variable codes
arxiv-2507-12534.creator: Ivan Rojkov, Elias Zapusek, Florentin Reiter
arxiv-2507-12534.description: Abstract Dissipative quantum error correction (QEC) autonomously protects quantum information using engineered dissipation and offers a promising alternative to error correction via measurement and feedback. However, scalability remains a challenge, as correcting high-weight errors typically requires increasing dissipation rates and exponentially many correction operators.

arxiv-2509-17957.title: On the Variational Costs of Changing Our Minds
arxiv-2509-17957.creator: David Hyland 1 and Mahault Albarracin 2
arxiv-2509-17957.description: Abstract The human mind is capable of extraordinary achievements, yet it often appears to work against itself. It actively defends its cherished beliefs even in the face of contradictory evidence, conveniently interprets information to conform to desired narratives, and selectively searches for or avoids information to suit its various purposes.

pmc-10525784.title: Lichens and Mosses as Biomonitors of Indoor Pollution
pmc-10525784.creator: Luca Paoli, Elena Bandoni, Luigi Sanità di Toppi, Zed Rengel
pmc-10525784.description: Simple SummaryHuman exposure to pollutants in indoor environments is a relevant health concern. Long-term monitoring data in indoor environments are largely missing due to a lack of adequate measuring devices. Biomonitoring (the use of living organisms to identify/assess potential hazardous exposure to chemicals and their effects) can provide useful information on indoor air quality and effects.

pmc-10660557.title: Forest products monetary contribution to households’ income: A means to improve the livelihood of a low-income rural community in South Ethiopia
pmc-10660557.creator: Eyasu Chama, Simon Shibru, Tizazu Gebre, Sebsebe Demissew, Zerihun Woldu
pmc-10660557.description: Forest products and forest-based activities in Ethiopia play a substantial economic contribution to the livelihoods of rural households. Despite its pivotal role, empirical data are inadequate on forests' monetary contribution across a range of ecological locations and social situation, particularly for rural agrarian communities of the developing nations, like Ethiopia.

pmc-11405667.title: Looming stimuli reliably drive innate defensive responses in male rats, but not learned defensive responses
pmc-11405667.creator: Mirjam Heinemans, Marta A Moita
pmc-11405667.description: Survival relies on an organism's intrinsic ability to instinctively react to stimuli such as food, water, and threats, ensuring the fundamental ability to feed, drink, and avoid danger even in the absence of prior experience. These natural, unconditioned stimuli can also facilitate associative learning, where pairing them consistently with neutral cues will elicit responses to these cues.

pmc-12511644.title: A Break from the Norm? Parametric Representations of Preference Heterogeneity for Discrete Choice Models in Health
pmc-12511644.creator: John Buckell, Alice Wreford, Matthew Quaife, Thomas O. Hancock
pmc-12511644.description: BackgroundAny sample of individuals has its own unique distribution of preferences for choices that they make. Discrete choice models try to capture these distributions. Mixed logits are by far the most commonly used choice model in health. Many parametric specifications for these models are available.

pmc-12533194.title: Paper-based colorimetric sensor for histamine detection using dopamine-functionalized, size-varied gold nanoparticles
pmc-12533194.creator: Rolen Brian P. Rivera, Ryan M. Lumod, Romnick B. Unabia, Renzo Luis D. Reazo, Archie G. Ruda, Melbagrace A. Lapening, Jahor L. Omping, Amyzz P. Ceniza, Noel Lito B. Sayson, Felmer S. Latayada, Rey Y. Capangpangan, Gerard G. Dumancas, Roberto M. Malaluan, Arnold A. Lubguban, Gaudencio C. Petalcorin,
pmc-12533194.description: Histamine, a prominent biogenic amine (BA), is commonly associated with allergic reactions and is a key culprit in foodborne illnesses stemming from spoiled food consumption. The detection of histamine is paramount for meeting food safety standards and ensuring quality control.

pmc-12618398.title: The effect of amlodipin, a calcium channel blocker, on tendon healing: an experimental study in rat model of Achilles tendon injury
pmc-12618398.creator: Sefa Erdem Karapinar, Umut Can Duvarci, Serdar Tunc, Unal Unsar Sarıısık, Omer Faruk Topcu, Recep Dincer, Serdar Kamil Cepni, Afra Gul Yonet, Ilkay Armagan, Orhan Berk Imeci, Halil Asci
pmc-12618398.description: PurposeAchilles tendon injuries represent a major clinical challenge due to the tendon’s poor vascularity and limited regenerative capacity. Amlodipine, a dihydropyridine calcium channel blocker, has demonstrated antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects in various tissues. However, its potential influence on tendon healing remains unexplored.

pmc-12665075.title: CYP82G1 Enzyme Functions as Chromone Hydroxylase in the Biosynthesis of 6‐Hydroxy‐2‐(2‐Phenylethyl)chromone in Aquilaria sinensis
pmc-12665075.creator: Wenli Wu, Tingting Yan, Yuanyuan Zhao, Xuan Zhang, Iain Wilson, Gaiyun Li, Hao Wang, Wenli Mei, Ruibo Wu, Xiaochen Sun, Luyuan Jiang, Xiaoyang Jiang, Fenjuan Shao, Deyou Qiu
pmc-12665075.description: Aquilaria sinensis , a plant of the genus Aquilaria in the family Thymelaeaceae, can form resinous and fragrant agarwood in response to wounding or infection. The resin physically occludes xylem vessels and ray parenchyma, limiting pathogen mobility and resource loss. The quality of agarwood is often evaluated using highly oxygenated 2‐(2‐phenylethyl)chromones, such as agarotetrol, 2‐[2‐(4‐methoxy)phenylethyl]chromone, 4′‐methoxyagarotetrol and 6,7‐dimethoxy‐2‐(2‐phenylethyl)chromone.

pmc-13001676.title: Transoral Approach for Balloon Dilation of the Eustachian Tube
pmc-13001676.creator: Jared Zhao, Bryan K. Ward
pmc-13001676.description: ObjectivesBalloon dilation of the Eustachian tube (BDET) is typically performed by advancing a balloon through the nasal cavity into the Eustachian tube orifice using a guide catheter. However, in patients with challenging nasal or Eustachian tube anatomy, this transnasal approach may be unsuccessful.

pmc-13199692.title: Hemoglobin-to-red cell distribution width ratio and sleep duration as predictors of pneumonia: Evidence from NHANES 2011–2018
pmc-13199692.creator: Yunhao Jiang, Chen Chen
pmc-13199692.description: ObjectivePneumonia remains a significant global health burden; however, accessible and robust predictors of community screening are limited. This study aimed to investigate the individual and synergistic associations of the hemoglobin-to-red cell distribution width ratio—a marker of systemic inflammation—and sleep duration with pneumonia prevalence using a nationally representative sample.

pmc-13203081.title: Morin and Morin Semicarbazone Combined with Fucoxanthin Have Potential Anti-Inflammaging Effects Through Modulation of Nrf2/HO-1 System in UVB-Exposed HaCaT Keratinocytes
pmc-13203081.creator: Sara García-Gil, Javier Ávila-Román, Azahara Rodríguez-Luna, Gabriela Rodríguez-García, Rosa E. del Río, Virginia Motilva, Mario A. Gómez-Hurtado, Elena Talero
pmc-13203081.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Ultraviolet (UV) radiation is a main environmental factor responsible for skin damage, leading to oxidative stress, inflammation, and impairment of the skin barrier function. Furthermore, many components in sunscreen may accumulate in aquatic systems, causing environmental pollution. Therefore, the identification of novel natural bioactives that counteract these effects and can be useful as effective adjuvants in sunscreen formulations is of particular interest. Morin (1), a natural flavonoid, represents an attractive scaffold for modifications to enhance its biological activity.

pmc-13321510.title: DcLcyB1 and DcLcyB2, two lycopene β-cyclases with partial functional overlap modulate carotene profiles in carrot roots via distinct catalytic properties
pmc-13321510.creator: Ya-Hui Wang, Pei-Zhuo Liu, Rong-Rong Zhang, Yu-Qing Zhang, Hui-Ru Wang, Yu-Jie Sun, Jing Ma, Zhi-Sheng Xu, Ai-Sheng Xiong
pmc-13321510.description: In plant, lycopene β-cyclase is a crucial enzyme in carotenoid metabolic pathway, which can induce color alteration. Carrots (Daucus carota) possess two genes encoding lycopene β-cyclase, namely DcLcyB1 and DcLcyB2. Little is known regarding the functional disparities between these two proteins in regulating carrot carotenoid accumulation.

pmc-13435374.title: Lower cardiac output is a risk factor for faster cerebral atrophy over a 11‐year follow‐up period in APOE‐ε4 carriers
pmc-13435374.creator: Elizabeth E Moore, Panpan Zhang, Omair A Khan, Dandan Liu, Deepak K Gupta, Kimberly R Pechman, Katherine A Gifford, Bennett A Landman, Timothy J Hohman, Angela L Jefferson

pmc-13567851.title: Contemporary Comparison between the Hemodialysis Reliable Outflow Device and Femoral Arteriovenous Graft
pmc-13567851.creator: Hind Anan, Amaan Rahman, Elonay Yehualashet, Jacob Weineberg, Theodore H. Yuo
pmc-13567851.description: Visual Abstract Introduction Central venous occlusion (CVO) affects 10% of all patients on dialysis and predialysis patients1 and typically leads to arteriovenous (AV) access malfunction.2 The 2019 Kidney Disease Outcomes Quality Initiative guidelines consider it reasonable to use a long-term tunneled dialysis catheter (TDC) in uncorrectable occlusions.
